retention.rolling_checkpoint_policy: Delete step_*.pt only after summary validation, best/final deserialization, SHA-256 capture, and completed cell verification are all successful.
retention.historical_artifact_policy: Never delete or overwrite exploratory checkpoints to make room for this study without explicit owner approval.

recovery.resume_policy: Resume only the newest step_*.pt belonging to the same experiment after successful checkpoint deserialization.
recovery.failure_policy: Retain the original log, failure record, and invalid checkpoint path; never silently replace a failed attempt.
recovery.external_storage_validation: The selected artifact root must exist on a writable filesystem, pass an atomic write-read-fsync-rename probe, and have at least the configured free-space threshold.
